actual_bindings.enforcement: Explicit caller source input and same-path output; outer host supplies materialization/hash/read/write guard.
Repository-relative glob on parsed source paths; caller must prove resolved set.
Semicolon OR is supported here; no empty/all default admitted implicitly.
All five manifest targets guarded even when only one target needs repair.
Ordered recipes, not an arbitrary task scheduler or merge authority.

algebra.union: Exact resolved set union; only text recipe semicolon OR is a source-verified direct binding here.
algebra.intersection: Ordinary edit-visitor preconditions are AND; this does not fence ScanningRecipe scanning/generation.
algebra.difference: Resolve and prove exact excluded path set; no generic set-difference executor is registered by this packet.
algebra.widen: New scope requires new input closure, donor fit, counterexamples and all gates before promotion.
algebra.narrow: Restrict inputs AND every allowed effect. A smaller changed-file count does not establish narrower authorization.
